correctness.rationale: For every p,q>=3 and r>=1, the incidence identity transfers line-graph inertia to Q-2I plus one negative index. Exact Schur complements show four subdivisions of any edge and two subdivisions of a bridge add balanced inertias without changing signature/nullity; this reduces all triples to exactly twenty base graphs. Exact rational congruence and a separately reconstructed direct line-graph matrix agree on all twenty base cases. 1320 additional rational checks pass, but the unrestricted theorem follows from the proved congruences and finite exhaustive base reduction, not extrapolation. All singular branches, parity cases and endpoints are covered.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete three-index classification for the connected bicyclic dumbbell family expressly left out of recent rose/theta results. It settles sharp signature-one equality, locates every adjacency singularity class and the unique maximum nullity-three regime, extending two isolated known equality examples to every parameter. The statement is structural and infinite, not an arbitrary finite instance, and the exact residue-parity distinctions help understand why the broader connected-line-graph signature conjecture fails only in more complex tested cactus configurations.
